## Describe the bug

Provide a clear and concise description of the problem.

## Steps to reproduce

Explain how to reproduce the issue.

1. Open Folio.
2. Navigate to the relevant area.
3. Perform the action.
4. Observe the problem.

## Expected behaviour

Describe what you expected to happen.

## Actual behaviour

Describe what happened instead.

## Affected area

Which part of Folio is affected?

- [ ] Note editor
- [ ] Handwriting or drawing
- [ ] Assignment tracker
- [ ] Calendar or table view
- [ ] Local storage or automatic saving
- [ ] Offline access
- [ ] Cloud synchronisation
- [ ] Authentication or account management
- [ ] User interface or accessibility
- [ ] Other

## Environment

**Device:** <!-- e.g. Windows laptop, MacBook, iPad, Android tablet -->

**Operating system and version:**

**Browser and version:** <!-- If applicable -->

**Folio version or commit:** <!-- If known -->

**Internet connection:** <!-- Online, offline, intermittent -->

## Offline or synchronisation details

Complete this section if relevant.

- Was the device online when the problem occurred?
- Did the problem occur after reconnecting?
- Were the same note or assignment being edited on multiple devices?
- Did any changes appear to be missing or overwritten?

## Screenshots or logs

Attach screenshots or relevant error messages if available.

Remove passwords, access tokens, private notes and other sensitive information before sharing.

## Additional context

Add anything else that might help investigate the issue.
